sn16.7:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Mahā-Kassapo yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || pe|| 3
sn16.7:1.3: Ekam antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantam Mahā-Kassapam Bhagavā etad avoca || ||
sn16.7:1.6: ahaṃ vā Kassapa bhikkhū ovadeyyaṃ tvaṃ vā ||
sn16.7:1.7: ahaṃ vā bhikkhūnaṃ dhammikathaṃ kareyyaṃ tvaṃ vāti || || 4
sn16.7:2.1: Dubbacā kho bhante etarahi bhikkhū dovacassakaraṇehi dhammehi samannāgatā akkhamā apadakkhinaggāhino anusāsaniṃ || || 5
sn16.7:2.2: Yassa kassaci bhante saddhā natthi kusalesu dhammesu || hiri natthi kusalesu dhammesu || ottappaṃ natthi kusalesu dhammesu || viriyaṃ natthi kusalesu dhammesu || paññā natthi kusalesu dhammesu || tassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati hāniyeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no vuddhi || || 6
sn16.7:3.1: Seyyathāpi bhante kāḷapakkhe candassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati hāyateva vaṇṇena hāyati maṇḍalena hāyati ābhāya hāyati ārohapariṇāhena ||
sn16.7:3.2: evam eva kho bhante yassa kassaci saddhā natthi kusalesu dhammesu || pe ||
sn16.7:3.6: paññā natthi kusalesu dhammesu || tassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati hāni yeva pātikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no vuddhi || || 7
sn16.7:4.1: Asaddho purisapuggalo ti bhante parihānam etaṃ ||
sn16.7:4.2: ahiriko purisapuggalo ti bhante parihānaṃ etaṃ ||
sn16.7:4.3: anottāpi purisapuggalo ti bhante parihānam etaṃ ||
sn16.7:4.4: kusīto purisapuggalo ti bhante parihānam etaṃ ||
sn16.7:4.7: upanāhī purisapuggalo ti bhante parihānam etaṃ ||
sn16.7:4.8: Na santi bhikkhū ovādakāti bhante parihānam etaṃ || || 8
sn16.7:5.1: Yassa kassaci bhante saddhā atthi kusalesu dhammesu || hiri atthi kusalesu dhammesu || ottappam atthi kusalesu dhammesu || viriyam atthi kusalesu dhammesu || paññā atthi kusalesu dhammesu || tassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati vuddhiyeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no parihāni || || 9
sn16.7:6.1: Seyyathāpi bhante juṇhapakkhe candassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati || vaḍḍhateva vaṇṇena vaḍḍhati maṇḍalena vaḍḍhati ābhāya vaḍḍhati ārohapariṇāhena ||
sn16.7:6.2: evaṃ eva kho bhante yassa kassaci saddhā atthi kusalesu dhammesu || pe ||
sn16.7:6.6: paññā atthi kusalesu dhammesu || tassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati || vuddhi yeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no parihāni || || 10
sn16.7:7.1: Saddho purisapuggalo ti bhante aparihānam etaṃ ||
sn16.7:7.2: Hirimā purisapuggalo ti bhante aparihānam etaṃ ||
sn16.7:7.3: ottāpī purisapuggalo ti bhante aparihānaṃ etaṃ ||
sn16.7:7.4: āraddhaviriyo purisapuggalo ti bhante aparihānam etaṃ ||
sn16.7:7.5: paññavā purisapuggalo ti bhante aparihānam etaṃ ||
sn16.7:7.6: akkodhano purisapuggalo ti bhante aparihānam etaṃ ||
sn16.7:7.7: anupanāhī purisapuggalo ti bhante aparihānam etaṃ ||
sn16.7:7.8: Santi bhikkhū ovādakāti bhante aparihānam etan ti || || 11
sn16.7:8.2: yassa kassaci Kassapa saddhā natthi kusalesu dhammesu || pe|| ||
sn16.7:8.6: paññā natthi kusalesu dhammesu || tassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati || hāni yeva paṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no vuddhi || || 12
sn16.7:9.1: Seyyathāpi Kassapa kālapakkhe candassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati || hāyateva vaṇṇena || pe || ||
sn16.7:9.3: Evam eva kho Kassapa yassa kassaci saddhā natthi || kusalesu dhammesu || pe||
sn16.7:9.7: paññā natthi kusalesu dhammesu || tassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati || hāni yeva pātikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no vuddhi || || 13
sn16.7:9.8: Asaddho purisapuggalo ti Kassapa parihānam etaṃ ||
sn16.7:9.14: upanāhī purisapuggalo ti Kassapa parihānam etaṃ ||
sn16.7:9.15: Na santi bhikkhū ovādakāti Kassapa parihānam etaṃ || || 13
sn16.7:10.1: Yassa kassaci Kassapa saddhā atthi kusalesu dhammesu || la ||
sn16.7:10.5: paññā atthi kusalesu dhammesu || tassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati vuddhi yeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammessu || || 14
sn16.7:11.1: Seyyathāpi Kassapa juṇhapakkhe candassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati || vaḍḍhateva vaṇṇena vaḍḍhati maṇḍalena vaḍḍhati ābhāya vaḍḍhati ārohapariṇāhena ||
sn16.7:11.2: evam eva kho Kassapa kassaci saddhā atthi kusalesu dhammesu || hiri atthi ||
sn16.7:11.5: paññā atthi kusalesu dhammesu || tassa yā ratti vā divaso vā āgacchati || vuddhiyeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no parihāni || 15
